## Functional assignment

The protein is **glycerol-3-phosphate dehydrogenase [NAD(P)+]**, **EC 1.1.1.94**.

This assignment is highly confident because the 332-residue sequence is an **exact full-length match** to the reviewed UniProt protein **B1M7L6**. Its domain architecture is also consistent with this enzyme:

- NAD_Gly3P_dh_N domain: residues 7–159  
- NAD_Gly3P_dh_C domain: residues 181–319  
- Predicted molecular mass: approximately **32.7 kDa**

## Catalytic reaction

The enzyme reduces dihydroxyacetone phosphate:

\[
\text{dihydroxyacetone phosphate} + \text{NAD(P)H} + H^+
\rightleftharpoons
\text{sn-glycerol-3-phosphate} + \text{NAD(P)}^+
\]

In the biosynthetic direction:

\[
\text{DHAP} + \text{NAD(P)H} + H^+
\rightarrow
\text{sn-glycerol-3-phosphate} + \text{NAD(P)}^+
\]

The product, **sn-glycerol-3-phosphate**, is a key precursor for **glycerophospholipid and membrane-lipid biosynthesis**. The enzyme is expected to be cytosolic. The annotation supports activity with either NADH or NADPH, although the sequence evidence alone does not establish the relative cofactor preference.
